senses.gloss: m. (טוב, cmp. טֶבַע) form, nature, character, peculiarity.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 7:2:5">Y. Ber. VII, 11ᵇ</cite> <he>ט׳ ברכה</he> the form of a benediction.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 13a">Kidd. 13ᵃ</cite> <he>ט׳ גטין וכ׳</he> the legal form of deeds of divorce and of betrothals.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 17:4">Gen. R. s. 17</cite> <he>אדם זה מה טִיבוֹ</he> this man (whom thou art going to create)—what will his nature (distinction) be?—

<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 1:8">Keth. I, 8</cite> <he>מה טיבו של זה</he> what is that man? <cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 1:9">Ib. 9</cite> <he>מה ט׳ של עובר זה</he> what is this expected child (who is its father)?—

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 108b:4">Snh. 108ᵇ</cite> <he>מה טִיבָם וכ׳</he> what is the nature of these seven days?—Sifra Emor ch. XVIII, Par. 14 <he>מה טִיבְךָ ליטע וכ׳</he> what art thou (what right hast thou) to put up thy tent &c.?; a. fr.
